items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Nat King Cole in comparison to George Benson; the interviewee responds only to the general comment about including vocals, showing no personal connection to Nat King Cole.

ctx.x: Do you have any projects that you are aspiring to accomplish?

I’m getting ready to record with Kamau Kenyatta again. This is the guy who did the Nat King Cole thing. We just talked a couple of days ago. They’re coming up on Monday. We’re going to collaborate on a proposed project.
I know once Wayne Shorter said – he said, “My booking agent could have me working 365 days out the year if I wanted to work that much.” So it seems like there’s no plethora of work for you.
